XMLDB.COMMENT: Airpay Courses — featured + cross-tenant sharing + request workflow

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_featured_courses
TABLE.COMMENT: Admin-curated list of courses to feature on the learner dashboard

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to {course}.id

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = all tenants; non-zero = scope to that tenant root

FIELD.NAME: sort_order
FIELD.COMMENT: Lower = shown first in the widget

FIELD.NAME: label
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional caption (e.g. 'Manager track', 'New this month')

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_courses_requests
TABLE.COMMENT: Sprint D — pull/request flow. A receiving-tenant manager (e.g. Public or ZEEA) requests that a specific Airpay course be added to their tenant's catalogue; the Airpay Super Admin sees the request in an inbox and approves or rejects. Approving inserts the corresponding row into local_sentientia_courses_tenant_share (the actual sharing data store). Rejecting closes the request without sharing.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {course}.id

FIELD.NAME: requesting_tenant
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant root that wants the course (e.g. 77 for Public)

FIELD.NAME: requester_userid
FIELD.COMMENT: userid of the manager who filed the request

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending | approved | rejected

FIELD.NAME: decided_by
FIELD.COMMENT: userid of the admin who approved/rejected (null while pending)

FIELD.NAME: decision_reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional rejection rationale shown back to the requester

FIELD.NAME: timedecided
FIELD.COMMENT: When the decision was made (null while pending)

INDEX.NAME: idx_tenant_status
INDEX.COMMENT: Manager outbox: 'find all requests from my tenant'

INDEX.NAME: idx_course_tenant_status
INDEX.COMMENT: Dedup: 'does my tenant already have a pending request for this course?'

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_course_type
TABLE.COMMENT: Course types (the 'identified as' labels such as E-learning or Classroom). ADR-032 course_lookups import: the BizLMS local_course_types rows keep their ids, because course.open_identifiedas holds a comma list of these ids. Written by the importer and by a future type manager. usercreated and usermodified name people: declared in the privacy provider.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Label shown to people

FIELD.NAME: shortname
FIELD.COMMENT: Short code, spaces stripped as BizLMS did

FIELD.NAME: tenant_path
FIELD.COMMENT: Org path the type belongs to, for example /1 or /77. NULL means no tenant: a BizLMS orgid 0 type (offered to every tenant) or a type whose org could not be resolved at import. Never an empty string.

FIELD.NAME: active
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 enabled, 0 disabled

FIELD.NAME: protected
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 for the five built-in types (ids 1 to 5): no edit and no delete

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user.id of the creator, 0 when unknown or erased

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user.id of the last editor, 0 when unknown or erased

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_course_category
TABLE.COMMENT: Custom course categories, a tree separate from Moodle's course_categories. ADR-032 course_lookups import: the BizLMS local_custom_category rows keep their ids, because course.open_categoryid holds one of them. usercreated and usermodified name people: declared in the privacy provider.

FIELD.NAME: parentid
FIELD.COMMENT: Parent category id, 0 for a top-level category

FIELD.NAME: path
FIELD.COMMENT: Category-tree path of ids, for example /3/12. Not an org path.

FIELD.NAME: tenant_path
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant root path of the owning org, for example /1. NULL means no tenant: visible to cross-tenant callers only. Never an empty string.

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user.id of the creator, 0 when unknown or erased

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to user.id of the last editor, 0 when unknown or erased

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_courses_detailfill
TABLE.COMMENT: ADR-032 course_lookups import trail: one row per course whose open_* columns the import filled from the BizLMS local_coursedetails row. detailid names that source row; filledcols lists the course columns the import wrote (each was empty before). The only way the frozen import framework reaches a core UPDATE is through rows of the importer's own tables, so this table exists for that and for audit. Ids and timestamps only, no personal data. Written by the importer only.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to course.id of the filled course

FIELD.NAME: detailid
FIELD.COMMENT: id of the local_coursedetails row the values came from

FIELD.NAME: filledcols
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma list of the course open_* columns the import filled, empty until the fill step has run

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: timecreated of the source row, 0 when the source had none

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: timemodified of the source row, 0 when the source had none

INDEX.NAME: uk_course
INDEX.COMMENT: A course is filled from one source row

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_courses_tenant_share
TABLE.COMMENT: Sprint C — many-to-many map (course × tenant) for cross-tenant course sharing. A course appears in tenant N's catalog if (a) its open_path is within tenant N's tree (the 'owned' path), OR (b) a row exists here with status='active' for (courseid, tenant_id=N). Completion data stays per-tenant via mdl_user.open_path.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to {course}.id

FIELD.NAME: tenant_id
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant root (1=Airpay, 77=Public, 177=ZEEA); matches the first segment of mdl_user.open_path. Must be > 0.

FIELD.NAME: shared_by
FIELD.COMMENT: userid of the admin who created this share

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: active | withdrawn — withdrawn rows keep history but don't gate catalog

FIELD.NAME: timeshared
FIELD.COMMENT: When this share was first created

KEY.NAME: uk_course_tenant
KEY.COMMENT: A course can only be shared to a given tenant once; toggling status re-uses the same row.

INDEX.NAME: idx_tenant_status
INDEX.COMMENT: Catalog query: 'find all active shares for tenant N'

INDEX.NAME: idx_status_courseid
INDEX.COMMENT: Admin dashboard: 'who has access to course X right now'

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_courses_remind_sent
TABLE.COMMENT: P1 #28: tracks every deadline-reminder notification fired by the course_reminder scheduled task. Lets the task de-dupe (don't nudge the same user × course × bucket twice) and gives admin a queryable audit trail of who got nudged when. Closes audit item #14 from parity-audit-2026-05-15/sentientia_courses.md.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User who received the reminder

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the deadline is on

FIELD.NAME: days_before_deadline
FIELD.COMMENT: Which configured bucket fired (e.g. 7, 3, 1). Lets one user get multiple reminders as the deadline approaches without re-firing the same bucket.

FIELD.NAME: deadline_ts
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts of the computed deadline at send time. Resetting completion (P1 #20) doesn't invalidate this row, but a new enrolment will compute a fresh deadline and so a fresh bucket.

INDEX.NAME: idx_user_course_bucket
INDEX.COMMENT: Dedupe key — one row per (user, course, bucket, deadline). Including deadline_ts lets fresh enrolments fire fresh nudges.

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_courses_enrolmove
TABLE.COMMENT: ADR-032 enrolments import ledger (gap G6): one row per orphaned BizLMS enrolment that the import converted to a manual enrolment. Names the original BizLMS method and instance, because the legacy map may not carry an id. Ids and timestamps only, no personal data. Written by the importer only.

FIELD.NAME: legacyueid
FIELD.COMMENT: user_enrolments.id of the BizLMS enrolment that was converted (left in place)

FIELD.NAME: legacyenrolid
FIELD.COMMENT: enrol.id of the BizLMS instance it was on (left in place)

FIELD.NAME: method
FIELD.COMMENT: The BizLMS enrol method: classroom, learningplan or program

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to course.id

FIELD.NAME: targetenrolid
FIELD.COMMENT: enrol.id of the manual instance the learner was enrolled on

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: timecreated of the legacy enrolment, kept from the source

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: timemodified of the legacy enrolment, kept from the source

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_courses_tagmove
TABLE.COMMENT: ADR-032 course_tags import trail: one row per tag_instance row that the BizLMS import moved in place from the local_courses/courses tag area to core/course. The row keeps its id; this table only records which ones moved, so the move can be counted, verified and, in a rehearsal, reversed. Ids and timestamps only, no personal data. Written by the importer only.

FIELD.NAME: taginstanceid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to tag_instance.id of the moved row

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: timecreated of the tag instance, kept from the source

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: timemodified of the tag instance, kept from the source

INDEX.NAME: uk_taginstance
INDEX.COMMENT: A tag instance is moved once
